$comment: Containerized development services (the development layer), as virtualisation.oci-containers. Dev-friendly: known or empty passwords, bound to localhost. The first ten are the same definitions as nix-desktops/omarchy's databases, so Omarchy takes their ids in its dbs.json. `category` is one of the catalog's CONTAINER_CATEGORIES; where two services share a default port, one moves to another host port and its description says so. `user` and `extraOptions` go to oci-containers as they are (`--network=host` only for tools that have to reach the other services on localhost; they listen on 127.0.0.1 themselves).
